subject: french
title: Indirect Speech and Passive
welcome_lead: Reported speech and the passive voice diversify your French. Shift tenses and rearrange agents.
meta_desc: French grammar: indirect speech, passive voice, gerund.
final_note: Voice and viewpoint move with grammar — control both.

concepts.def: Sequence of tenses in reported speech.

walkthroughs.body_html: Present > imparfait; passe compose > plus-que-parfait; futur > conditionnel. Il dit qu'il viendra > Il a dit qu'il viendrait.
Le livre a ete ecrit par Camus. Agent introduced by par. The participle agrees with the subject.
En lisant, j'apprends = simultaneity. Il a reussi en travaillant dur = manner.
